resources.string: Auto uses the last confirmed channel. Where supported, Android 14+ lists channels allowed for Wi-Fi Direct; otherwise common non-DFS candidates are shown. A selected channel is tried first when the car is disconnected from Wi-Fi. If rejected, DiPlay tries other channels.
Turn the car’s Wi-Fi switch on. Allow Location / Nearby devices if requested and enable Location when Android asks. If playback stutters, try the built-in car hotspot at 5 GHz.
